boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Endicott spaces for study, arts, services, and campus connection, documented by College sources.

cards.title: Callahan Center
cards.subtitle: Endicott’s student center
cards.notes: Use this central building to connect with student services, pick up campus information, or pause between classes; it is open to students year-round.
cards.short_summary: A student-services and gathering hub with dining, the bookstore, and programming nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott identifies Callahan as its student center, open 24/7 to students during the academic year, with dining, an information booth, and student services.
cards.access_notes: The College states it is open 24/7 to students throughout the academic year; services within may have separate availability.

cards.title: Commuter & Veterans Lounge
cards.subtitle: Lower Callahan Center
cards.notes: If you commute or are a veteran, use the Lower Callahan lounge to study, relax between classes, or learn about upcoming programs.
cards.short_summary: A designated Lower Callahan space for commuters and veterans between classes.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott says the Commuter & Veterans Lounge in Lower Callahan is for veterans and commuters to study, hang out, meet others, and relax.
cards.access_notes: Designed for Endicott commuters and veterans; confirm any current lounge access details with Student Life.

cards.title: Diane Meyers Halle Library
cards.subtitle: Main campus library
cards.notes: Start here when you need a campus study destination or want to locate Endicott’s archival materials alongside other library resources.
cards.short_summary: Endicott’s map-listed library and home base for the College archives.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott’s interactive campus map lists Diane Meyers Halle Library among academic facilities and student services.
cards.access_notes: Check the library directly for current building hours, visitor rules, and service availability.

cards.title: Endicott Archives
cards.subtitle: Inside Diane Meyers Halle Library
cards.notes: Visit with a specific campus-history question in mind; the archives hold photographs, yearbooks, correspondence, and objects documenting Endicott.
cards.short_summary: A library-based collection for tracing the College’s people, buildings, academics, and athletics.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott reports that its archives, located inside Halle Library, contain yearbooks, correspondence, sports equipment, and more than 4,000 photographs.
cards.source_title: 10 Hidden Gems on Endicott’s Campus | Endicott College
cards.access_notes: Located inside Halle Library; contact the library or archives before planning research access.

cards.entity_name: Walter J. Manninen Center for the Arts
cards.title: Walter J. Manninen Center for the Arts
cards.subtitle: Main campus arts center
cards.notes: Check the arts calendar, then use the building as a starting point for exhibitions, performances, and creative work across its named venues.
cards.short_summary: A single campus building that brings galleries, theaters, studios, and arts community spaces together.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott describes Manninen as a main-campus arts facility with theaters, galleries, studios, and student and faculty lounges.
cards.source_title: Walter J. Manninen Center for the Arts | Endicott College
cards.access_notes: Exhibitions and performances may follow separate schedules; verify the event or venue before visiting.

cards.title: Carol Grillo Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Walter J. Manninen Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Look for the current exhibition and plan time to view work by students, faculty, local artists, or other community exhibitors.
cards.short_summary: A Manninen Center gallery presenting student and community exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott identifies Carol Grillo Art Gallery as a public gallery where students, faculty, guests, and North Shore community members can view local, student, and faculty work.
cards.source_title: Visual and Performing Arts Facilities | Endicott College
cards.access_notes: Located in the Manninen Center; confirm current gallery hours and exhibition dates before visiting.

cards.title: Heftler Visiting Artist Gallery
cards.subtitle: Walter J. Manninen Center for the Arts
cards.notes: See whether a visiting exhibition or gallery talk is scheduled, then use the gallery to engage directly with works connected to arts study.
cards.short_summary: A museum-quality gallery for visiting exhibits, talks, and community shows.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott describes the Heftler Visiting Artist Gallery as a museum-quality space for visiting art exhibits, gallery talks, and community shows.
cards.source_title: Walter J. Manninen Center for the Arts | Endicott College
cards.access_notes: Located in the Manninen Center; access depends on the current exhibition and building schedule.

cards.title: Spencer Presentation Gallery
cards.subtitle: Walter J. Manninen Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Use this teaching-gallery setting to slow down with exhibited work and connect what you see to class discussion or independent observation.
cards.short_summary: A gallery and art-history classroom designed for studying works in person.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott identifies the Spencer Presentation Gallery as a teaching gallery and art-history classroom where professors and students discuss works in class.
cards.source_title: Visual and Performing Arts Facilities | Endicott College
cards.access_notes: Located in the Manninen Center; classroom and exhibition use may affect availability.

cards.title: Rose Theater
cards.subtitle: Walter J. Manninen Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Check upcoming campus performance listings and attend a scheduled music, theater, or dance event in this dedicated performance hall.
cards.short_summary: A 250-seat Manninen Center hall built for performances with professional-quality acoustics.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott describes Rose Theater as a 250-seat performance hall with professional-quality acoustics.
cards.source_title: Visual and Performing Arts Facilities | Endicott College
cards.access_notes: Performance access is event-based; verify the program’s time, ticketing, and entry guidance before going.

cards.title: Tia's Theater
cards.subtitle: Walter J. Manninen Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Watch for drama, dance, or technical-theater programming and use the intimate black-box setting to support student performance work.
cards.short_summary: A 100-seat black-box venue for drama, dance, workshops, and performances.
cards.evidence_claim: Endicott identifies Tia's Theater as a 100-seat black-box theater for drama, dance, technical-theater workshops, and performances.
cards.source_title: Visual and Performing Arts Facilities | Endicott College
cards.access_notes: Performance access is event-based; consult the Center’s current schedule before attending.
